summary: Lofi hip hop ('lofi girl' beats): 60-90 BPM, sparse swung drums low-passed and pushed back, a warm round bass on the chord roots (or none), 2-4 jazzy 7th/9th chords on a held Rhodes; knowledge/style/lofi.json is its template

checked.by: claude (lofi recipe from the web, after the producer's notes)

body: Tempo 60-90 BPM, usually 70-85; slower than most hip hop.

Drums: sparse, often just kick, snare (or rim) and hats; each low-passed and pushed back in the mix, soft, swung (a J Dilla lean: off-beats late, ghost notes between hits). A snappy kick with some low end, never a booming 808 tail or a big gated snare. The producer wants TR-808 drums for it (2026-11-26), softened, not a jazz kit.

Bass: many lofi tracks have none; when there is one it plays the chord roots with a gentle, warm, round patch, low-passed hard (cutoff 150 Hz to a few hundred), never boomy and never masking the kick. The producer prefers the song's own bass kept and warmed over a sampled fretless (2026-11-26).

Harmony: 2-4 chords looping, simple rhythms, jazz colours (7ths, 9ths; ii-V-I, vi7-IVmaj7), on a soft Rhodes or piano held as a pad: soft attack, chords ringing through the bar, never short choppy hits (the producer's correction, 2026-11-26).
Texture: the whole mix warm and dusty, the top rolled off; vinyl crackle or tape wobble optional; no distortion on the master.
Toward it gradually: every part crossfades over the bars, the drums too, never jumping in (the producer, 2026-11-26).

Sources (2026-11-26): Native Instruments 'How to make lofi music' and 'Lo-fi hip hop'; Mode Audio 'LoFi Hip Hop: 5 Production Essentials'; Lunacy 'How to Make Lofi Music'; Produce Like A Pro 'What is lo-fi music'.

Apply: pattern/boombap-1 on the drums, then pattern/lofi-vamp-vi-iv on the keys four bars later, plus the production chain on the master. For a whole style change the Team Lead's restyle uses knowledge/style/lofi.json instead.

drums.about: the drum track (a kit); leave out if there isn't one

keys.about: a chordal part (keys, pad); leave out if there isn't one

key.about: the project's key; leave out to estimate it from the notes
